asset_heavy.reason: HMCA operates diagnostic imaging centers with costly MRI scanners and facilities; this management segment is the larger part of the business.

big_ticket.reason: Main business is per-scan imaging management services, small frequent transactions; MRI scanner sales are a smaller segment.

cyclical_demand.reason: Diagnostic imaging for patients is medical care, which is rarely postponed in a downturn.

large_customers.reason: Customers are patients, insurers and physician practices; MRI buyers are mostly imaging centers and physicians, not large enterprises.

notes: Larger segment is HMCA's management of diagnostic imaging centers; MRI manufacturing is the smaller segment.

offers_products.reason: FONAR manufactures and sells UPRIGHT Multi-Position MRI scanners, though the larger part of the business is the HMCA services segment.

offers_services.reason: HMCA manages diagnostic imaging centers, offering management, billing, equipment, maintenance and non-medical staff to medical providers.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue is driven by MRI scanners, imaging centers and management infrastructure, not mainly the time and skill of staff.

recurring_revenue.reason: HMCA earns ongoing management fees and patient scan revenue from managed imaging centers and practices, which is repeat, ongoing business.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Patients are scanned at the managed imaging centers and choose where to go, so individuals are among the main buyers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells MRI scanners to providers and provides management services to medical practices and imaging centers; insurers also pay.
